critique.evidence: Measured performance is demo-ready across all three viewports: LCP is 548–704 ms, FCP 52–76 ms, TTFB 1.3–5.8 ms, and load completes in 141–237 ms. CLS is 0 on mobile, 0.001 on desktop, and a still-acceptable but higher 0.0478 on tablet. There are no console, page, or request failures; all recorded API calls return 200; and no horizontal document overflow is present. Frame tests show no long frames, though desktop averages 20.73 ms with a 33.4 ms worst frame. The main performance liability is payload size: 1,314,022 transferred bytes, including 1,148,898 bytes of JavaScript, for 17 requests.
critique.fix: Reduce the roughly 1.15 MB JavaScript payload through route-level code splitting and dependency trimming; then identify and reserve space for the tablet element causing CLS 0.0478. Profile the desktop render path to bring average frame time closer to 16.7 ms.
